vpn.title: Connect to the corporate VPN
vpn.summary: Step-by-step guide for Windows, macOS and mobile devices.
vpn.body:
1. Install the GlobalProtect client from the self-service portal.
2. Enter portal: vpn.northstar.example.
3. Sign in with your corporate account (SSO).
4. On TLS handshake errors, check system time and root certificates.
5. If the issue persists, create an incident tagged vpn.

data.title: Working safely with corporate data
data.summary: Classifying, storing and sharing information without risk.
data.body:
Classify data: Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted.
Store Confidential only in approved systems (SharePoint, OneDrive for Business).
Do not send Restricted data via external email without encryption.
When in doubt, request a security review from the catalog.

laptop.title: First day: set up your new laptop
laptop.summary: Everything you need for a productive start at the company.
laptop.body:
Power on and complete Entra ID join.
Install required apps from Company Portal.
Connect VPN and verify Northstar portal access.
Set up MFA within the first 24 hours.

mfa.title: Set up multi-factor authentication
mfa.summary: Register Authenticator and recover access if you lose your phone.
mfa.body:
1. Open aka.ms/mfasetup while on the corporate network or VPN.
2. Add Microsoft Authenticator as the primary method.
3. Save recovery codes in a password manager.
4. Test sign-in on a second device before leaving the office.
5. Lost device? Contact IAM via the service catalog immediately.

outlook.title: Outlook keeps asking for a password
outlook.summary: Clear cached credentials and re-establish modern authentication.
outlook.body:
1. Sign out of Office apps and close Outlook.
2. Remove Northstar credentials from Windows Credential Manager.
3. Open Outlook and complete the modern auth prompt.
4. If the loop continues, repair Office from Apps & features.
5. Escalate with tag outlook-auth if MFA challenges never appear.
